Still copying data between apps by hand?
Form to spreadsheet, spreadsheet to Slack, every single day. Miss one, and a customer waits.
Fix found: Active pieces. Building blocks for your busywork, with an open-source core.
Pick a trigger, like a schedule or a new form entry.
Add steps from hundreds of apps: Google Sheets, Slack, Gmail, even an A.I. prompt.
Test each step, publish, and it runs by itself, on your own server.
The catch: single sign-on, roles and audit logs need a paid licence.
And the one-command install is for personal use. Real workloads need a database, a queue and file storage.
